text:
The Best Expat Spot on the East Side of the River
If you are on the East side of the river, this is the premier Western expat bar in the area.

The environment is genuinely solid. The playlist is great, they have TVs for sports, and it is an ideal spot to sit down and have a good conversation.

You do need to manage your expectations regarding the service. The hospitality industry here is reactive, not proactive. Do not expect servers to make regular rounds to check your drinks; you will need to actively flag them down when you need something.

Also, be aware there is a 5% surcharge if you use a credit card.
As for the food, I highly recommend eating elsewhere before you arrive. They try to push an Australian theme, but the execution is lacking. There is incredible food all over the city, so save your appetite for those spots.

So why the high rating? Because I’ve been coming here regularly for a month, and it is undeniably the best spot on this side of the bridge for a drink. They have outdoor seating that opens up at 9:00 PM with a fantastic view of the bridge. You might walk in and feel slightly underwhelmed, but if you look around the neighborhood, you will quickly realize there isn't another comparable option without calling a ride. It essentially holds a monopoly on the expat bar scene in this specific area, and for the drinks and the view alone, it is absolutely worth your time.

text:
ダナンに来て、夜はどこで飲もうかと川沿いを歩いていたら、賑わっているバーを見つけました。それがこの「バンブーツーバー」です。お店はハン川に面した開放的な造りで、涼しい風が通り抜けてとても気持ちが良かったです。

店内に入ると、大勢の欧米人観光客や地元の人がお酒を楽しんでいて、とても活気がありました。一階の通りに面した席でビールを飲んでいる人も多く、私もそこで飲んでみました。道行く人や川の景色を眺めながらの一杯は格別ですね。

メニューはビールやカクテル、フードも豊富にあります。私はビールが好きなので、タイガービールを注文しました。キンキンに冷えていて、のどごしもよく、何杯もおかわりしてしまうほど美味しかったです。フードも評判が良いようなので、次回は試してみたいですね。

スタッフの方は英語が堪能で、とてもフレンドリーでした。日本語を勉強しているスタッフもいるようです。陽気な音楽が流れていて、お客さん同士が気軽に話している雰囲気も素敵です。二階にはソファー席、三階にはビリヤード台もあるので、気分に合わせて過ごし方を変えられるのも良いですね。夜遅くなるとさらに人が増えて盛り上がるようです。
textTranslated:
When I arrived in Da Nang and was walking along the river in the evening, wondering where to have a drink, I stumbled upon a lively bar. That bar was "Bamboo Tou Bar." The bar has an open design facing the Han River, and the cool breeze blowing through was very pleasant.

Inside, there were many Western tourists and locals enjoying drinks, creating a very lively atmosphere. Many people were drinking beer at the tables on the ground floor facing the street, so I tried that too. A drink while watching people go by and the river scenery was exceptional.

The menu offers a wide variety of beers, cocktails, and food. Since I love beer, I ordered a Tiger Beer. It was ice-cold, refreshing, and so delicious that I ordered several refills. The food also seems to have a good reputation, so I'd like to try it next time.

The staff were fluent in English and very friendly. It seems some staff members are studying Japanese. The cheerful music playing and the casual conversations among the customers created a wonderful atmosphere. The second floor has sofa seating, and the third floor has a billiard table, so you can change how you spend your time depending on your mood. It seems to get even more crowded and lively late at night.

음악이 약간 컨트리풍임ㅎ

신청곡 하셈! 한국인의 힘을 보여줘야함.
여기는 노래만 잘 틀어도 난리날텐데 노래가 아쉬움.

한국인은 의무적으로 신청곡 해야함. 대신 나라 얼굴이 있으니 좋은걸로 부탁.

우리는 데킬라 병으로 시키고 신청곡 하긴 했음ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 신청곡 7개인가 했는데 5개는 틀어준듯!

직원들이 다 너무 친절하고 권유 없고 눈치도 빠름.
근데 술 쫌 마시는 사람들은 병으로 시켜도 금방 마셔버림. 대신 신청곡 틀어야 기분 좋아야 많이 마심.
우리는 비가 왔었는데 분위기 지리고 뭐랄까.... 낭만?ㅎ

비흡연자는 옆에 담배피는 사람 있으면 힘들 수 있음.
하지만 바람이 잘 불어서 밖에 앉으면 1분 숨 침고 견딜 수 있음.

Tham 직원분 레알 천사임. 번역기 돌려서 소통하셈.
이상!
textTranslated:
The music has a bit of a country vibe, haha.

Make some song requests! You need to show the power of Koreans.

If they just played good music, this place would be a sensation, but the selection is a bit lacking.

Koreans are obligated to request songs. But since you represent the country, please ask for something good.

We ordered a bottle of tequila and did request songs, lol. We requested about 7 songs, and they played about 5 of them!

The staff are all so friendly, don't pressure you to drink, and are very perceptive.

However, people who drink a bit tend to finish it quickly even if they order a bottle. But you need to be in a good mood to have your requests played to drink a lot.

It was raining when we were there, but the atmosphere was incredible... what should I say... romantic? haha.

Non-smokers might find it difficult if there is someone smoking next to them.

But the breeze blows well, so if you sit outside, you can hold your breath and endure it for a minute.

The staff member at Tham is a real angel. Use a translator to communicate.

That's all!

text:
Bamboo is such a staple of Da Nang. I've been coming here since 2015 and really couldn't imagine this city without it. The view of the dragon Bridge from the patio is amazing. The people watching is great. The seating area is big enough to fit a lot of people once you realize you can sit upstairs, downstairs and outside.

I suppose I shoupd mention, the food is great. For the longest time, they served the only real burger in Vietnam. Now a days, there are quite a few places that serve good hamburgers, but back in the day this was really the only spot.

Bamboo 2 caters to the Aussie crowd. You'll find the flag flying in front and a steady stream of ACDC playing inside. (Not all the time, but a lot) which is fine with me.

The seafood is fresh, the burgers are fantastic, the staff is friendly and professional, and the view is second to none. Bamboo 2 is the perfect place to drink some time away and have a blast while in Da Nang.
